nodes.label: Fable-Style Architecture & Planning (ruleset)
nodes.rationale: Discover before designing, decide load-bearing first, delegate cheap work, verify against ground truth, leave a written decision trail.

nodes.label: Rule 1: Refuse to spend the window on easy work
nodes.rationale: Classify tasks by cost-to-reverse/subsystem span/subtlety/precedent; push mechanical work to cheaper models, keep only decomposition/tradeoffs/verification on the expensive model.
nodes.norm_label: rule 1: refuse to spend the window on easy work

nodes.label: Rule 2: One big brief; ask only what the repo cannot answer
nodes.rationale: Assemble full context first, then ask at most five questions only for facts no artifact can supply.
nodes.norm_label: rule 2: one big brief; ask only what the repo cannot answer

nodes.label: Rule 3: Plan load-bearing decisions first, features second
nodes.rationale: Order planning by cost-to-reverse: invariants and data contracts first, execution/ownership model second, features last; write irreversible decisions as ADRs with a named revisit trigger.
nodes.norm_label: rule 3: plan load-bearing decisions first, features second

nodes.label: Rule 4: High effort means options with trade-offs, not longer prose
nodes.rationale: At every genuine fork generate 2-3 options, state the trade-off, pick one, record why losers lost.
nodes.norm_label: rule 4: high effort means options with trade-offs, not longer prose

nodes.label: Rule 5: Maintain one project brain, and keep it verified
nodes.rationale: Keep a single CLAUDE.md as the brain backed by docs/adr/; update only with facts the code cannot say itself.
nodes.norm_label: rule 5: maintain one project brain, and keep it verified

nodes.label: Rule 6: Verify before reporting: try to break your own output
nodes.rationale: Three passes before calling anything done: ground truth check against the repo, adversarial 'what breaks this', and root-cause proof for bug fixes.
nodes.norm_label: rule 6: verify before reporting: try to break your own output

nodes.label: Rule 7: Gate on results: every phase ends with a branch decision
nodes.rationale: After each result explicitly choose proceed/refine/escalate; define the gate before delegated work starts.
nodes.norm_label: rule 7: gate on results: every phase ends with a branch decision

nodes.label: Rule 8: Treat over-specified prompts and ambient noise as advisory
nodes.rationale: Extract intent from rigid templates/false-positive hooks and adapt to what discovery found, noting the conflict in one line.
nodes.norm_label: rule 8: treat over-specified prompts and ambient noise as advisory

nodes.label: Rule 9: The failure path still holds everything the attempt acquired
nodes.rationale: Recovery code runs inside the wreckage of the failing attempt; release locks/rollback before opening a second transaction to record failure, else a silent lock-wait hang results.
nodes.norm_label: rule 9: the failure path still holds everything the attempt acquired

nodes.label: Fan-in concurrency safety (_advance() row locking)
nodes.rationale: _advance() takes with_for_update() with deterministic order_by(id) on pending sibling rows so the last committer sees every sibling's completed status and enqueues exactly once; drain() also exits when Investigation.status=='failed' to avoid polling forever on a permanently-stuck dependent.
